name: PickPair – Upsells, Cross-sells, Order Bumps, One-Click Upsells & Related Products for WooCommerce
author: YS Innovations

sections.description:
Do you want to make more money from your online store without spending extra money on ads? You need PickPair.

PickPair is the ultimate WooCommerce upsell plugin and cross sell plugin built to help you grow your business effortlessly. It shows the right product offers to your buyers at the exact right time—on product pages, inside the shopping cart, during checkout, and after purchase.

Instead of installing many slow plugins, PickPair gives you an all-in-one sales booster suite designed to maximize your revenue. It is fully compatible with standard WooCommerce pages and modern WooCommerce Cart & Checkout Blocks.

When running an e-commerce business, turning casual visitors into high-paying buyers is the key to long-term success. PickPair automates this entire process for you. By combining smart product recommendations, product bundles, and targeted marketing funnels, your store will effortlessly generate higher revenue from every single visitor without any manual effort.

💡 What Does PickPair Do for Your Store?

If you run an online shop, your main goal is to get customers to buy more items during every visit. PickPair helps you increase your Average Order Value (AOV) automatically by showing smart product recommendations at every step of the buyer’s journey:

  • On Product Pages: Uses Frequently Bought Together widgets to show matching items that look great together so buyers can purchase a complete set.
  • In the Shopping Cart: Uses cart upsells and cross-sells to suggest extra items or a free shipping progress bar to encourage larger orders.
  • At Checkout: Displays quick, 1-click checkboxes for checkout order bumps right before payment.
  • After Purchase: Shows special thank you page upsells so customers come back to buy again.

🌟 Main Features to Grow Your Sales

  • Frequently Bought Together (Amazon Style): Show matched items on product pages. Buyers can check items and add the whole set to their cart with one click using bundle discounts.
  • Smart Cart Upsells & Cross-Sells: Show related product recommendations inside the cart so buyers add more items before paying.
  • Checkout Order Bumps: Add special offers (like gift wrap, extra warranty, or fast shipping) right on the checkout page with a single checkbox.
  • Upsell Popups: Show a nice pop-up window when buyers click “Add to Cart” to suggest extra items right away.
  • Thank You Page Upsells: Show special one-time deals on the order success page after the customer buys.
  • Free Shipping Progress Bar: Show a live progress bar in the cart (for example: “Add $10 more to get Free Shipping!”) so buyers spend more.
  • Smart Rules: Show specific offers based on cart value, product categories, customer user roles, or customer login status.
  • Easy Revenue Analytics: See clear reports on your dashboard showing total extra money, views, clicks, and sales from every offer.

🚀 Why Store Owners Choose PickPair

Running an online shop takes hard work. Here is why store owners love using PickPair to grow their business faster:

  • Make More Money From Existing Traffic: You do not need to buy more ads. PickPair helps you sell more items to the people who are already visiting your store.
  • Save Time With All-in-One Tools: Instead of buying separate plugins for pop-ups, product bundles, order bumps, and cart bars, you get everything inside one neat dashboard.
  • Easy Setup for Beginners: You do not need any coding skills. Everything is visual, clean, and ready to use in just a few minutes.
  • Happy Customers: By showing useful items (like matching batteries for a toy or a protective case for a phone), you help your buyers find what they actually need.

🛒 How Different Store Types Use PickPair Every Day

  • Electronics & Gadgets Shops: Bundle a phone with a screen case and charger, and add a 2-year warranty at checkout using WooCommerce product bundles.
  • Clothing & Fashion Stores: Show matching belts, socks, or bags when someone views a jacket or shoes using smart cross-sells.
  • Beauty & Makeup Shops: Create a skincare set (Cleanser + Cream) with a 15% discount.
  • Home & Furniture Stores: Offer setup help or delivery insurance right above the add to cart button.
  • Pet Supplies & Animal Care: Suggest favorite chew toys, grooming brushes, or vitamin treats when buyers add pet food to their cart.
  • Pharmacy & Healthcare Stores: Bundle daily vitamins with immunity boosters or add a pill organizer at checkout as an easy order bump.
  • Adult & Lifestyle Boutiques: Discreetly suggest complementary care items, designer accessories, or special gift packaging in the cart.
  • Sports & Fitness Gear: Bundle a yoga mat with a carry strap, water bottle, and a workout guide.
  • Food & Sweet Manufacturing: Bundle popular sweets and traditional snacks into a festival gift box set with special discounts.
  • Jewelry & Luxury Shops: Offer matching earrings or custom gift cleaning kits when a customer views a necklace.
  • Digital Products & Online Courses: Recommend a companion workbook or an advanced video module right when someone views the main book or course.

⚡ Fast, Light, and Simple for Everyone

  • No Slow Speed: Loads fast and only runs on pages where your offers are active.
  • Mobile Friendly: Looks great on mobile phones, tablets, and computers.
  • Cache Safe: Works smoothly with popular speed and cache plugins like WP Rocket and LiteSpeed Cache.
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Search for PickPair.
  3. Click Install Now and then Activate.
  4. Go to the PickPair menu in your WordPress sidebar.
  5. Create your first offer and start selling more!
sections.faq:
Does PickPair work with WooCommerce checkout blocks?

Yes! It works great with both old standard WooCommerce pages and new WooCommerce Cart & Checkout Blocks.

Will this plugin slow down my website?

No. PickPair is coded cleanly to keep your website fast and smooth for all visitors.

Can I give bundle discounts?

Yes! You can give percentage discounts, fixed price cuts, or special bundle prices using powerful product bundles.

Can I show offers for specific categories?

Yes. You can choose to show offers based on specific products, whole categories, or total cart price.

Can I check how much extra money I made?

Yes. The built-in analytics page shows total sales, clicks, and views for every campaign.

1.0.6 August 20, 2026

  • Added Cart Add-on and Product Add-on Upsell and Cross-sell features.
  • Implemented order history-based conditions for upsell and add-on campaigns with UI support.

1.0.5 August 13, 2026

  • Added Upsell Popup feature.

1.0.4 August 7, 2026

  • Added Thank you page Upsell.

1.0.3 July 31, 2026

  • Added a new price type setting to choose between sale price and regular price.
  • Updated product price retrieval to respect the selected price type across recommendations and campaigns.
  • Introduced Free and PRO feature gating.

1.0.2 July 24, 2026

  • Fixed: prevent adding a product as its own add-on and filter add-ons accordingly.
  • Fixed: update product display positions and improve product selection handling in campaign editors.
  • Fixed: update product add-ons label for clarity and adjust container style.
  • Fixed: update trigger type to “all” across components for consistency.
  • Fixed: adjust placement of the plugin configuration message on the Settings page.
  • Fixed: dropdown overflow while editing on the listing page and card overflow issues.
  • Updated: layout and styling for editor pages, including overflow handling.
  • Updated: display location for bundles and upsells to “top” across components.

1.0.1 July 17, 2026

  • Added a deactivation feedback survey on the Plugins screen.
  • Added dashboard analytics REST API with revenue, conversion, and campaign performance stats.
  • Improved campaign list API with pagination, search, multi-type filters, sorting, and status counts.
  • Added per-campaign views and revenue stats in the admin campaign list.
  • Added a custom PickPair admin menu icon.
  • Improved admin asset loading with hashed bundle support and cache-busting.
  • Rebuilt the React admin UI with dashboard, campaign pages, shared layout, and editor components.
  • Expanded and clarified the WordPress.org plugin readme and FAQ content.

1.0.0 July 13, 2026

  • Initial public release.
  • Added Frequently Bought Together campaigns.
  • Added Product Bundles.
  • Added Product Page Add-ons.
  • Added Cart Recommendations.
  • Added Cart Upsells.
  • Added Checkout Recommendations.
  • Added Rules & Conditions.
  • Added campaign targeting by products, categories, cart subtotal, customer roles, and previous orders.
  • Added Campaign Analytics.
  • Added WooCommerce Cart & Checkout Blocks support.
  • Added AJAX-powered cart interactions.
  • Added responsive frontend layouts.
  • Added stock validation for bundled products.
  • Added parent-child cart relationships.
